description: Representation-insensitivity pin (2026-08-20 incident): the wrapper's `required` array is DERIVED from properties iteration order — an order-unstable source (a document-store Map round-trip legally reorders object keys). `required` is set-semantics in JSON Schema, so the canonical form sorts every `required` array (derived and authored, at every depth); two representations of one contract MUST build byte-identical canonical schemas and one propsSchemaHash. This case lists properties in NON-sorted insertion order; a builder that reproduces iteration order emits required:["tickets","asOf"] and fails both the schema and hash compare.

samples.note: asOf required regardless of declaration order
tickets required regardless of declaration order
